chapter.li: LEChapter8 Verse1 And when Jesus had come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him. VerseEnd Verse2 And behold, there came a leper worshipping him, saying, Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean. VerseEnd Verse3 And Jesus put forth his hand and touched him, saying, I am willing. Be clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed. VerseEnd Verse4 And Jesus said unto him, See you tell no man, but go your way and show yourself to the priests, and offer the gift that Moses commanded for a testimony unto them. VerseEnd

Verse5 And when Jesus had entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, imploring him VerseEnd Verse6 and saying, Lord, my servant lies at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented. VerseEnd Verse7 And Jesus said unto him, I will come and heal him. VerseEnd Verse8 The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that you should come under my roof; but speak the word only and my servant shall be healed. VerseEnd Verse9 For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me. And I say to this man, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does it. VerseEnd Verse10 And when they that followed him heard this, they marveled. And when Jesus heard this, he said unto them that followed, Truly I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel. VerseEnd Verse11 And I say unto you that many shall come from the east and the west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of Heaven. VerseEnd Verse12 But the children of the wicked one shall be cast out into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth. VerseEnd Verse13 And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go your way, and as you have believed, be it done unto you. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour. VerseEnd

Verse14 And when Jesus had come into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother laid and sick of a fever. VerseEnd Verse15 And he touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she arose and ministered unto them. VerseEnd Verse16 Now when the evening came, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils, and he cast out the evil spirits with the word, and healed all that were sick, VerseEnd Verse17 that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities and bore our sicknesses. VerseEnd

Verse18 Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side VerseEnd Verse19 of the sea. And a certain scribe came unto him and said, Master, I will follow you wherever you go. VerseEnd Verse20 And Jesus said unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head. VerseEnd Verse21 And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father. VerseEnd Verse22 But Jesus said unto him, Follow me and let the dead bury their dead. VerseEnd

Verse23 And when he had entered into a ship, his disciples came unto him. VerseEnd Verse24 And behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves, but he was asleep. VerseEnd Verse25 And his disciples came unto him and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us, else we perish. VerseEnd Verse26 And he said unto them, Why are you fearful, O you of little faith? Then he arose and rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm. VerseEnd Verse27 But the men marveled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him? VerseEnd

Verse28 And when he had come to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him a man possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that no man could pass that way. VerseEnd Verse29 And behold, he cried out, saying, What have we to do with you, Jesus, you Son of God! Have you come here to torment us before the time? VerseEnd Verse30 And there was, a good way off from them, a herd of many swine feeding. VerseEnd Verse31 So the devils implored him, saying, If you cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine. VerseEnd Verse32 And he said unto them, Go. And when they had come out, they went into the herd of swine, and behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea and perished in the waters. VerseEnd Verse33 And they that kept them fled and went their way into the city, and told everything which took place, and what had befallen to the possessed of the devils. VerseEnd Verse34 And behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus. And when they saw him, they implored him that he would depart out of their region. VerseEnd

LEChapter9 Verse1 And Jesus entered into a ship and passed over and came into his own city. VerseEnd Verse2 And behold, they brought to him a man, sick of the palsy, lying on a bed. And Jesus, knowing their faith, said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, be of good cheer; your sins are forgiven you. Go your way and sin no more. VerseEnd Verse3 And behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemes. VerseEnd Verse4 And Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, Why is it that you think evil in your hearts? VerseEnd Verse5 For is it not easier to say, Your sins are forgiven you, than to say, Arise and walk? VerseEnd Verse6 But I said this, that you may know that the Son of Man has power on earth to forgive sins. Then Jesus said unto the sick of the palsy, Arise, take up your bed, and go unto your house. VerseEnd Verse7 And he immediately arose and departed to his house. VerseEnd Verse8 But when the multitude saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such power unto men. VerseEnd

Verse9 And as Jesus passed forth from there, he saw a man named Matthew sitting at the place where they received tribute, as was customary in those days, and he said unto him, VerseEnd Verse10 Follow me. And he arose and followed him. And it came to pass as Jesus sat at a meal in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and with his disciples. VerseEnd Verse11 And when the Pharisees saw them, they said unto his disciples, Why does your master eat with publicans and sinners? VerseEnd Verse12 But when Jesus heard them, he said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician, but they that are sick. VerseEnd Verse13 But go and learn what this means: I desire mercy, and not sacrifice. For I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance. VerseEnd

Verse14 And while he was thus teaching, there came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but your disciples fast not? VerseEnd Verse15 And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast. VerseEnd

Verse16 Then said the Pharisees unto him, Why will you not receive us with our baptism, seeing we keep the whole law? But Jesus said unto them, You keep not the law. If you had kept the law, you would have received me, for I am he that gave the law. I receive not you with your baptism because it profits you nothing, for when that which is new has come, the old is about to be put away; for no man puts a piece of new cloth on an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up takes from the garment, and the rent is made worse. VerseEnd Verse17 Neither do men put new wine into old bottles, else the bottles break, and the wine runs out, and the bottles perish. But they put new wine into new bottles and both are preserved. VerseEnd

Verse18 While he spoke these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dying, but come and lay your hand upon her and she shall live. VerseEnd Verse19 And Jesus arose and followed him, and also his disciples, and many people crowded him. VerseEnd Verse20 And behold, a woman who was diseased with a discharge of blood twelve years came behind him and touched the hem of his garment; VerseEnd Verse21 for she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole. VerseEnd Verse22 But Jesus turned himself about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; your faith has made you whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour. VerseEnd

Verse23 And when Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise, VerseEnd Verse24 he said unto them, Give place, for the maid is not dead, but sleeps. And they laughed him to scorn. VerseEnd Verse25 But when the people were put forth, he went in and took her by the hand, and the maid arose. VerseEnd Verse26 And the fame of Jesus went abroad into all that land. VerseEnd

Verse27 And when Jesus departed from there, two blind men followed him, crying and saying, Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on us. VerseEnd Verse28 And when he had come into the house, the blind men came to him, and Jesus said unto them, Do you believe that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord. VerseEnd Verse29 Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith, be it unto you. VerseEnd Verse30 And their eyes were opened. And sternly he charged them, saying, Keep my commandments and see you tell no man in this place, that no man know it. VerseEnd Verse31 But they, when they had departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country. VerseEnd

Verse32 And as they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil. VerseEnd Verse33 And when the devil was cast out, the dumb man spoke. And the multitude marveled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel. VerseEnd Verse34 But the Pharisees said, He casts out the devils through the prince of the devils. VerseEnd Verse35 And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people. VerseEnd Verse36 But when he saw the multitude, he was moved with compassion on them because they were weary and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd. VerseEnd

Verse37 Then he said unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the laborers are few. VerseEnd Verse38 Ask therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth laborers into his harvest. VerseEnd LEChapter10 Verse1 And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease. VerseEnd
